description: This file defines the 'gamemap' class, which encapsulates the game map for Wesnoth, including terrain types, locations, map manipulation, and related data structures and functions.

classes.name: gamemap
classes.description: Represents the game map, including terrain data, starting positions, and map operations.

classes.name: gamemap::location
classes.description: Represents a specific location on the game map with coordinate and directional utilities.

classes.name: gamemap::incorrect_format_exception
classes.description: Exception thrown when the map file format is invalid.

methods.name: underlying_terrain
methods.description: Returns the underlying terrain name for a given terrain type.

methods.name: parse_direction
methods.description: Parses a string into a direction enum value.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes the map to a string.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Loads map data from a string.

methods.name: overlay
methods.description: Overlays another map onto this map at specified coordinates.

methods.name: x
methods.description: Returns the width of the map.

methods.name: y
methods.description: Returns the height of the map.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses terrain data at a specific row index.

methods.name: get_terrain
methods.description: Retrieves terrain at a specific location.

methods.name: starting_position
methods.description: Gets the starting position for a given side.

methods.name: is_starting_position
methods.description: Checks if a location is a starting position.

methods.name: num_valid_starting_positions
methods.description: Returns the number of valid starting positions.

methods.name: set_starting_position
methods.description: Sets a starting position for a side.

methods.name: on_board
methods.description: Checks if a location is within map bounds.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map has zero size.

methods.name: villages
methods.description: Returns a list of village locations.

methods.name: get_terrain_info
methods.description: Retrieves terrain type information for a terrain or location.

methods.name: get_terrain_list
methods.description: Returns the list of terrain types.

methods.name: set_terrain
methods.description: Sets terrain at a specific location.

methods.name: get_weighted_terrain_frequencies
methods.description: Returns terrain frequency data weighted by proximity to map center.

methods.name: remove_from_border_cache
methods.description: Removes cached border terrain data for a location.
